convention.floors: Each new/changed module/class/callable >=90% lines; every changed production module >=75% branches; no decrease against its applicable baseline; no uncovered changed executable line.
convention.line_mapping: Map accepted validation qualified units and changed executable lines to the final bytes. Preserve raw coverage rather than manufacturing a declaration-inclusive denominator.
convention.overall_scope: Retained helper114 proof plus final remaining graph/caller proof; no repository-wide coverage percentage or whole-feature completion claim.
convention.range_convention: Bind current AST qualified names/ranges separately from coverage.py named summaries. Raw AST ranges intersect module executable/missing lines and originating branch lines; do not equate them to named-unit summary denominators because declaration exclusions differ.

validation_baseline.source: Shared baseline references accepted P2-T9 proof.

regressions.qualification: Prior exact unchanged-body proof is referenced separately; current coverage JSON has not been augmented.

scope_proof.current_changed_callable_requirement: All mapped prior executed lines and branch destinations of _inventory remain covered; every changed executable line is covered; new callable coverage is at least 90%.
scope_proof.retained_requirement: Only exact unchanged callable AST bodies retain P2-T6 proof. Retained coverage is separate from the current raw coverage report.
